intentEvidence: By default, Obsidian's Markdown renderer collapses any number of consecutive blank lines into a single paragraph break in reading mode.
motivation: The author needed consistent spacing when migrating notes from Zim desktop wiki to Obsidian, as Zim preserves blank lines.
problem: Obsidian's default Markdown renderer collapses multiple consecutive blank lines into a single paragraph break in reading mode, leading to cramped visual spacing.
summary: A plugin that preserves consecutive blank lines in Obsidian's reading mode, ensuring visual spacing matches the source text exactly.
